mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_SEQ FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, r.HOST_SEQ, r.TITLE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.STATUS, r.CATEGORY, r.STARTED_AT, r.ENDED_AT, r.CREATED_AT, r.DISCONNECTED_AT, r.ENDED_BY, r.END_REASON, m.LOGIN_ID AS HOST_LOGIN_ID, m.NICKNAME AS HOST_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIVE_VIEWER v WHERE v.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ AND v.LEFT_AT IS NULL) AS VIEWER_COUNT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM LIVE_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = r.HOST_SEQ WHERE r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq}
SELECT r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, r.HOST_SEQ, r.STATUS, r.STARTED_AT, r.THUMBNAIL_URL FROM LIVE_ROOM r WHERE r.HOST_SEQ = #{hostSeq} AND r.STATUS = 'LIVE'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_LIVE_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LIVE_ROOM ( LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, HOST_SEQ, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, THUMBNAIL_URL, STATUS, CATEGORY, STARTED_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{live_room_seq}, #{host_seq}, #{title}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thumbnail_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'LIVE', #{category}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE LIVE_ROOM SET STATUS = 'ENDED', ENDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, ENDED_BY = #{endedBy}, END_REASON = #{endReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND STATUS = 'LIVE'
UPDATE LIVE_ROOM SET DISCONNECTED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND STATUS = 'LIVE'
UPDATE LIVE_ROOM SET DISCONNECTED_AT = NULL WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND STATUS = 'LIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT LIVE_ROOM_SEQ FROM LIVE_ROOM WHERE STATUS = 'LIVE' AND DISCONNECTED_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{seconds}, 'SECOND')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIVE_HASHTAG (LIVE_HASHTAG_SEQ, LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, TAG) VALUES (LIVE_HASHTAG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{liveRoomSeq}, #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT TAG FROM LIVE_HASHTAG WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} ORDER BY LIVE_HASHTAG_SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIVE_VIEWER WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIVE_VIEWER (LIVE_VIEWER_SEQ, LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, JOINED_AT, KICKED_YN) VALUES (SEQ_LIVE_VIEWER.NEXTVAL, #{liveRoomSeq}, #{memberSeq}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE LIVE_VIEWER SET LEFT_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL
